thread:
Priya: quick heads-up — starter sample app fails when run with --json-mode. Tool/function returns a single-item array but our schema validator expects an object, so it throws and the onboarding flow aborts.
Alex: Which SDK runtime is this? node or browser?
Priya: TS node starter (starter-web-chat). Repro: `node ./start --json-mode` -> `SchemaError: expected object, got array`.
Diego: Ugh. I remember we had a Node shim that auto-unwrapped single-element arrays for legacy tools. The TS SDK helper didn't get the same treatment during the last refactor. Parity gap.
InfraBot: CI: build 4521 failed (samplekit-jsonmode.integration) — failing test: `should-accept-tool-output-object-or-array`.
Priya: Example payload from the model/tool: `[{"type":"upsert","payload":[{"id":"1","text":"hello"}]}]` — we want `{type,payload}` not an array.
Alex: Proposal: add `normalizeToolOutput(raw, schema, {mode})` to the TS helper. Minimal, safe transforms: unwrap single-element arrays, detect and parse double-encoded JSON strings, and if schema expects object but got array->take first element. Leave everything else alone.
Diego: +1, but make it opt-in via config: `jsonMode: 'strict' | 'forgiving'` so we don't silently hide legit schema mismatches. Also emit telemetry `tool_normalization_applied=true/false` so we can track how often this happens.
Priya: For onboarding we should set samplekit to `'forgiving'` so copy-paste users don't hit this. Keep default for new SDK users as `strict`.
Alex: Also watch out for retry/auth wrappers that might double-stringify payloads during a retry. Add a test for that. Suggested test snippet: ```ts
// simulate retry wrapper double-encode
const payload = JSON.stringify({type: 'upsert', payload: []});
const doubleEncoded = JSON.stringify(payload);
expect(normalizeToolOutput(doubleEncoded, objSchema, 'forgiving')).toEqual({type: 'upsert', payload: []});
```
Diego: I'll add the helper and a set of unit tests: unwrap-array, double-encode, non-matching fallback. And integration test in samplekit.
Priya: I'll update onboarding/docs page "Structured output and JSON mode" explaining why models sometimes return arrays or strings and how the helper behaves. Small note on security: Do not attempt arbitrary evals; only JSON.parse and shape checks.
Alex: Good call. Also include a short migration note for teams who relied on the old Node shim.
Diego: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/283 — WIP: adds normalizeToolOutput + telemetry + tests.
InfraBot: CI: build 4522 queued (will run on PR merge).
Priya: Thanks all. This should stop a bunch of confusing onboarding errors. Drop any additional sampleapp failures here and we'll prioritize. :sparkles:
